message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Check & fix styling

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**.php'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  php-code-styling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}

      - name: Cache Composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Fix PHP code style issues
        uses: aglipanci/laravel-pint-action@2.6

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v7
        with:
          commit_message: Fix styling
",
  "rationale": "Added a Composer dependency cache (actions/cache) to avoid repeated downloads on each run, supported by the distributed caching experiment (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE). Also added a job-level timeout of 10 minutes to prevent runaway executions, supported by the custom timeout pattern (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) and history-based timeout experiment (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT). Both changes preserve the existing styling check and auto-commit behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT",
    "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336"
  ]
}
